protocol.title: independent-initialization persistent-Memory replication
protocol.status: two untouched initializations; protocol frozen before training

primary: formation of >=95% 16-chunk query behavior under the frozen Level 6.8 curriculum
causal necessity of persistent Memory and final-layer Memory
secondary: fresh linear decodability of final-layer Memory on deployed source errors
generalization of the Memory-to-query-hidden read gap across initializations

fresh_probe_diagnostic.probe: one linear 16-way classifier per feature with frozen standardization
fresh_probe_diagnostic.role: secondary diagnostic only; probes cannot gate or modify the model

registered_classification.strong_independent_replication: both initializations pass the per-seed primary gate
registered_classification.conditional_independent_replication: exactly one initialization forms and passes the primary gate, while the other fails formation
registered_classification.causal_replication_failed: a formed model fails the causal primary gate
registered_classification.secondary_read_gap: reported separately and never changes the primary classification

protocol.stop_rule: record the registered classification; do not rescue a failed seed or add a third seed

diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Record this classification; do not extend, replace a seed, rescue an output head, or reopen router repair.
